title: Nobody Saw
pitch: Pendant que JJ travaille, des voleurs se servent tranquillement chez elle. Le clip alterne le bureau chorégraphié (énergie, humour) et le jardin cambriolé (routine de voleurs sans gêne). Au retour, il ne reste plus rien, sauf une vieille chaise cassée. Personne n'a rien vu, personne ne l'aide. Elle s'endort sur son canapé et se fait justice dans un rêve ultra cinématographique, puis se réveille, amère mais soulagée.
concept:
Ton : rock, punchy, autodérision. La colère est réelle, l'humour la rend visible.
C'est un clip, pas un film : on n'illustre pas chaque parole, on choisit des images fortes et on laisse respirer.
Pré-intro sans musique (son in : réveil, oiseaux, portail, pas), la musique démarre au bloc 2.
Images signatures : le vélo qu'elle astique avant d'aller travailler ; le portail qu'elle ferme soigneusement et que les voleurs ignorent ; le combat façon Kill Bill / John Wick 4 (overhead, ralentis, néons, couleurs saturées).
Arc : elle fait tout bien, personne ne la protège : alors, pendant quelques secondes, elle se fait justice dans son rêve.
da:
Ambiance « vraie vie » d'une jeune cadre.
JJ est directrice dans un cabinet de conseil : au travail, elle a le look d'une jeune cadre de cabinet de conseil. Pas de Doc Martens, pas de look rock.

shots.detail: JJ in @jj-bureau, still at her desk in @bureau-et-open-space with the phone receiver in one hand, throws both arms up in exasperation, head tipped back, eyes rolling to the ceiling, then lets her arms drop with a slap on her thighs. Around her @les-collegues keep working, unmoved. Medium shot, frontal, 35mm, static camera. Daylight from large windows mixed with cool LED ceiling panels, natural contrast, cool grey-blue and white palette: a real consulting-firm office, not a stylized set. Comic exasperation: tell me again what I'm supposed to do. A big physical beat, no shouting.
shots.script: JJ lève les bras, exaspérée.

shots.description: Plan fixe : porte, clôture.
shots.notes: Plan 32 du dossier. Paroles : When the door's no use and the fence won't do. | Le paillasson est posé ici pour préparer son vol (plan 38) et le rêve (plan 60).
shots.detail: Locked-off still shot in @jardin-de-jj: the blue-grey front door of the house under its awning, the coir @paillasson-welcome lying on the stone threshold, and beside it the wall, the hedge and @portail-du-jardin still standing wide open since the thieves left, all intact and useless. The door stays shut; only a leaf moves in the breeze. A clean graphic composition, the door on one third, the wall line running across the frame. Medium-wide, eye level, 35mm, static camera. Bright clear sunlight, crisp defined shadows, clean sky, high contrast. Dry irony: the door is no use and the fence won't do. No people in frame. The WELCOME lettering readable.
shots.script: Plan fixe : porte, clôture.

shots.description: Rue silencieuse, rideaux : un rideau bouge, puis se referme.
shots.camera: slow pan ending on a window
shots.notes: Plan 33 du dossier. Paroles : Nobody saw, nobody heard, | Rideau qui bouge puis se referme : v2 (plan 13 v2).
shots.detail: @rue-du-quartier, silent in the sun: closed shutters, tall hedges, net curtains. The camera drifts slowly along the facades and settles on one window where a curtain shifts slightly; a gap opens for a second, as if someone were looking out, then the curtain falls back and closes. Nobody appears. Wide to medium-wide, 50mm, slow pan ending on the window. Bright flat sunlight, bleached highlights, short shadows, still air. Pointed satire: the neighbours are there, but nobody is going to say a word. No face, no hand visible behind the curtain.
shots.script: Rue silencieuse, rideaux : un rideau bouge, puis se referme.

shots.description: JJ regarde ses collègues, aucun ne réagit.
shots.notes: Plan 34 du dossier. Paroles : Nobody's gonna say a word.
shots.detail: JJ in @jj-bureau, at her desk in @bureau-et-open-space, looks up and around at @les-collegues, half expecting a reaction, a look, anything. None comes: they stay bent over their screens, typing, headsets on, locked in their routine. She turns her head from one to the other, eyebrows raised. Medium shot over JJ's shoulder toward the rows of desks, 35mm, static camera with a slow rack focus from her to the colleagues. Daylight from large windows mixed with cool LED ceiling panels, natural contrast, cool grey-blue and white palette: a real consulting-firm office, not a stylized set. Quiet comic isolation. The colleagues do not dance and do not look up.
shots.script: JJ regarde ses collègues, aucun ne réagit.

shots.description: Plateau dansé, version plus intense.
shots.notes: Plan 35 du dossier. Paroles : In broad daylight… | 8,62 s : trop long pour Veo, voir notes.md.
shots.detail: @plateau-de-danse, second chorus, harder than the first: @jj in her stage-tailored consulting outfit (fitted navy suit, white blouse, black pumps) leads a sharper, faster routine, stamping her heels on the accents and gliding on her rolling office chair across the glossy floor, while the office-styled stage dancers behind her slam folders shut and spin their chairs in tight formation. The light is harsher: strobes on the snare hits, red and white beams cutting through thicker haze. Wide shot, low angle, 24mm, continuous slow orbit around her. Dark cyclorama, glossy black floor, saturated reds and whites, high contrast. Anger turned into energy. No loafers, no boots, no rock styling. The dancers are stage performers, not her office colleagues.
shots.script: Plateau dansé, version plus intense.

shots.description: Le chien abandonne, se couche.
shots.notes: Plan 36 du dossier. Paroles : While I'm earning my pay… | « Se couche contre la vitre » : v2 ; « la patte posée dessus » : v1, non refusé.
shots.detail: @alister gives up. Behind a glass pane of the house in @jardin-de-jj he lets out one last half-hearted bark, then slowly lies down against the glass, chin on the floor, one front paw resting against the pane, eyebrows raised in a sad, defeated look while the thieves come and go outside. Medium close-up at floor level through the glass, 50mm, static camera, faint reflection of the sunny courtyard on the pane. Bright sunlight outside, dim room inside. Tragicomic. No tear, no digital crying: only the raised eyebrows.
shots.script: Le chien abandonne, se couche.

shots.description: Les voleurs s'éloignent ; le dernier part avec le paillasson « Welcome » sous le bras.
shots.notes: Plan 37 du dossier. Paroles : And they walk away. | Vol du paillasson : v2 (plan 27 v2), absent du compilé. Voir notes.md.
shots.detail: @les-voleurs leave @jardin-de-jj for good. They walk out through the open @portail-du-jardin and down the sunny pavement of @rue-du-quartier, relaxed, hands in pockets; the last one stops on the stone threshold, picks up the coir @paillasson-welcome, tucks it under his arm and follows the others. Wide shot from the courtyard, framed by the open gate, 28mm, static camera; they get smaller down the street. Bright clear sunlight, crisp defined shadows, clean sky, high contrast. Petty to the end: they even take a worthless doormat. And they walk away.
shots.script: Les voleurs s'éloignent ; le dernier part avec le paillasson « Welcome » sous le bras.

shots.description: JJ face caméra dans le jardin vide, plan moyen, elle rappe droit dans l'objectif. Trace claire du salon dans le gravier, place vide du vélo, chaise cassée seule.
shots.notes: Plan 38 du dossier. Paroles : I was at my desk, I was doing my part, | « Plan moyen, rap droit dans l'objectif » : v2 (plan 34 v2).
shots.detail: JJ in @jj-bureau raps straight into the lens, hard and fast, standing in @jardin-de-jj: 'I was at my desk, I was doing my part'. Around her the emptiness shows: the flattened, paler rectangle in the gravel where the patio set stood, the empty spot against the wall where the bike was, the bare stone threshold. The only object left is @chaise-en-plastique-cassee, alone behind her. Jaw tight. Medium shot, frontal, 35mm, static camera at eye level. Bright clear sun, sharp shadows, an almost too-beautiful sky, high contrast. Direct anger. Mouth clearly visible for lip-sync.
shots.script: JJ face caméra dans le jardin vide, plan moyen, elle rappe droit dans l'objectif. Trace claire du salon dans le gravier, place vide du vélo, chaise cassée seule.

shots.description: Insert bureau (1 s) : écran, clavier, lumière froide.
shots.notes: Plan 39 du dossier. Paroles : I was at my desk… | v2 : « JJ à son poste, concentrée » ; compilé : sans JJ. Gardé le compilé.
shots.detail: One-second insert in her own director's office in @bureau-et-open-space: tight shot of JJ's polished mahogany desk, the glowing screen with a blurred work document, the keyboard, the black desk phone at the edge of frame. Perfectly still and ordered, nobody in frame, only the cursor blinking. Close-up, slightly high angle, 50mm, static camera. Cool flat ceiling light of a real consulting-firm office, clinical and ordered, desaturated blue-grey: the visual opposite of the sunlit courtyard, so one glance tells we are elsewhere. 'I was at my desk.' The cut is hard and lasts about one second. No people, no hands, no post-its.
shots.script: Insert bureau (1 s) : écran, clavier, lumière froide.

shots.description: Retour jardin, plan qui recule avec elle.
shots.notes: Plan 40 du dossier. Paroles : Paying my taxes, paying this town.
shots.detail: Back in @jardin-de-jj: JJ in @jj-bureau walks toward the camera across the empty gravel, rapping 'Paying my taxes, paying this town' with hard, clipped delivery, one hand cutting the air on each stress. The camera tracks backward at her pace, keeping her in a medium shot; behind her, @chaise-en-plastique-cassee alone, the pale trace of the stolen patio set, @portail-du-jardin standing open. She glances off at the empty courtyard, then back toward the lens. Medium shot, 35mm, steady backward dolly. Bright clear sun, sharp shadows, too-beautiful sky, high contrast. Driven, defiant. Mouth clearly visible for lip-sync.
shots.script: Retour jardin, plan qui recule avec elle.

shots.description: Plan serré sur le visage.
shots.notes: Plan 41 du dossier. Paroles : This city takes and takes and takes,
shots.detail: Tight close-up on JJ's face in @jardin-de-jj, the collar of @jj-bureau at the bottom of frame, as she raps 'This city takes and takes and takes', each 'takes' bitten off harder, jaw clenched. Her eyes avoid the lens: she stares off to the side at the empty spot where her bike stood, and only snaps back toward camera on the last 'takes'. Curls moving with the rhythm. Close-up, 85mm, static camera, shallow depth of field, the sunlit empty courtyard blurred behind her. Bright sun from above, crisp shadow under the brow, high contrast. Contained fury. Mouth clearly visible for lip-sync.
shots.script: Plan serré sur le visage.

shots.description: Elle désigne du doigt le vide, la place où était le vélo.
shots.notes: Plan 42 du dossier. Paroles : And when I need it, nobody's around. | « L'emplacement vide du vélo » : v2 (plan 36 v2).
shots.detail: In @jardin-de-jj, JJ in @jj-bureau points hard, whole arm extended, at the empty spot against the house wall where her bike used to stand, a faint tyre mark left in the gravel, while rapping 'And when I need it, nobody's around'; on 'nobody's around' her eyes snap from the empty spot straight into the lens. Medium shot, 35mm, static camera, slightly low angle, the empty spot visible beside her, @chaise-en-plastique-cassee at the edge of frame. Bright clear sun, sharp shadows, high contrast. Accusing and sharp. Mouth clearly visible for lip-sync.
shots.script: Elle désigne du doigt le vide, la place où était le vélo.

shots.description: Plan large, jardin vide.
shots.notes: Plan 43 du dossier. Paroles : File a report, sign it, go home, | v2 mettait ici la plainte en ligne sur le téléphone. Voir notes.md.
shots.detail: Wide shot of @jardin-de-jj: the whole courtyard empty, the flattened paler rectangle in the gravel where the patio set stood, the bare spot where the bike was, @chaise-en-plastique-cassee alone in the middle, and @portail-du-jardin wide open onto @rue-du-quartier. JJ in @jj-bureau stands small at one side, arms crossed, looking at the void, not at the camera. Wide, 24mm, high angle, static camera, symmetrical. Bright clear sun, sharp shadows, too-beautiful sky, high contrast. The void must be seen: file a report, sign it, go home.
shots.script: Plan large, jardin vide.

shots.description: Elle s'assoit sur la chaise cassée, face caméra, bras écartés.
shots.notes: Plan 44 du dossier. Paroles : Same empty yard, same open gate. | « Face caméra, bras écartés » : v2 (plan 37 v2) ; la chaise qui s'affaisse : v2 (plan 33 v2).
shots.detail: JJ in @jj-bureau drops onto @chaise-en-plastique-cassee in the middle of @jardin-de-jj, facing the camera; the cracked chair sags under her and the loose rung wobbles, but it holds. She spreads her arms wide, palms up, rapping 'Same empty yard, same open gate' into the lens, and on 'open gate' turns her head toward the open @portail-du-jardin. Medium shot, frontal, 35mm, static camera at seated eye level; behind her, the empty gravel and the open gate. Bright clear sun, sharp shadows, high contrast. Bitter and sarcastic. Mouth clearly visible for lip-sync.
shots.script: Elle s'assoit sur la chaise cassée, face caméra, bras écartés.

shots.description: Insert bureau (1 s) : JJ épuisée, tasse vide.
shots.notes: Plan 45 du dossier. Paroles : Work all week to pay for nothing, | v2 : « elle fixe son écran, mâchoire serrée » ; compilé : « épuisée, tasse vide ». Gardé le compilé.
shots.detail: One-second insert in her own director's office in @bureau-et-open-space: JJ in @jj-bureau, slumped in her beige leather executive chair at her mahogany desk late in the day, exhausted, chin on her fist, staring at the screen. She tips her mug, finds it empty, and sets it down next to the keyboard. Medium close-up, 50mm, static camera. Cool flat ceiling light of a real consulting-firm office, the floor-to-ceiling window behind gone dim, desaturated blue-grey, ordered: the opposite of the sunlit courtyard. Work all week to pay for nothing. Weariness, no comedy. The cut is hard and lasts under two seconds. No post-its.
shots.script: Insert bureau (1 s) : JJ épuisée, tasse vide.

shots.description: Jardin, plan frontal, regard caméra direct.
shots.notes: Plan 46 du dossier. Paroles : They work one hour and get it all straight.
shots.detail: Frontal shot in @jardin-de-jj: JJ in @jj-bureau stands dead center, feet planted, facing the lens, and delivers the last rap line straight into camera, 'They work one hour and get it all straight', slow and cutting, then holds the stare in silence for the last beat, jaw set. Behind her, perfectly centered, @chaise-en-plastique-cassee alone on the empty gravel, the pale trace of the patio set, @portail-du-jardin standing open. Medium shot, 35mm, static camera at eye level, strict symmetry. Bright clear sun, sharp shadows, too-beautiful sky, high contrast. Defiant and final. Mouth clearly visible for lip-sync.
shots.script: Jardin, plan frontal, regard caméra direct.

shots.description: JJ assise sur son canapé, téléphone à l'oreille, lumière froide intérieure ; au bout du fil, une voix calme et standardisée.
shots.notes: Plan 47 du dossier. Paroles : "I understand your frustration." | Téléphone et voix standardisée : v2 (plan 42 v2) et ajustement de Michael (le pont au canapé).
shots.detail: JJ sits on the grey sofa of @salon-de-jj, still in her office outfit, phone pressed to her ear, listening to a calm, standardized voice on the line saying it understands her frustration. She does not answer, staring ahead toward the window. Medium shot, frontal, 35mm, locked-off static camera. Cold bluish interior light, dim, low contrast, desaturated palette. Everything falls away after the rap: quiet, heavy, no gag. The music has dropped to a dirty guitar. Her lips stay closed. No phone screen, no text.
shots.script: JJ assise sur son canapé, téléphone à l'oreille, lumière froide intérieure ; au bout du fil, une voix calme et standardisée.

shots.description: Elle remonte les jambes en tailleur, s'adosse.
shots.notes: Plan 48 du dossier. Paroles : "I understand your sense of injustice."
shots.detail: On the sofa of @salon-de-jj, JJ, phone still at her ear, slowly draws her legs up and folds them cross-legged, then leans back into the high backrest, shoulders dropping, while the calm voice says it understands her sense of injustice. Her face is tired and closed. Medium shot, frontal, 35mm, locked-off static camera. Cold bluish interior light, dim, low contrast, desaturated palette. Slow and still, no gag: she is settling in, the viewer does not yet guess she will fall asleep. She does not speak.
shots.script: Elle remonte les jambes en tailleur, s'adosse.

shots.description: Elle pose la tête sur le dossier, ferme les yeux. Plan du dessus.
shots.notes: Plan 49 du dossier. Paroles : "I understand."
shots.detail: Overhead shot, camera straight above the sofa of @salon-de-jj: JJ, cross-legged, lets her head fall back onto the top of the backrest and closes her eyes; the hand holding the phone sinks to her lap. Her curls spread over the grey fabric. It must read as exhaustion, a pause: the viewer must not understand that she is falling asleep. Top-down overhead, 28mm, locked-off static camera. Cold bluish interior light, dim, low contrast, desaturated palette. Stillness. This exact position and outfit return at the wake-up. No gag.
shots.script: Elle pose la tête sur le dossier, ferme les yeux. Plan du dessus.

shots.description: Silence, souffle : gros plan sur son visage, paupières closes. Le « No » est en voix off.
shots.notes: Plan 50 du dossier. Paroles : No. | Paupières closes : v2 (plan 44 v2) ; « No » en voix off : v2 (plan 45 v2).
shots.detail: Close-up of JJ's face resting against the sofa backrest in @salon-de-jj, eyelids closed, completely still except for one slow, deep breath that lifts her chest and stirs a curl on her cheek. The 'No.' is heard as her own voice-over, low; her lips do not move. Close-up, 85mm, locked-off static camera, shallow depth of field. Cold bluish interior light, dim, low contrast, desaturated palette. Suspended silence before the turn; the viewer still does not know she is asleep. No gag.
shots.script: Silence, souffle : gros plan sur son visage, paupières closes. Le « No » est en voix off.

shots.description: Gros plan sur ses yeux qui s'ouvrent. Transition : flash ou zoom brutal vers le rêve.
shots.notes: Plan 51 du dossier. Paroles : You don't.
shots.detail: Extreme close-up of @jj's closed eyes in @salon-de-jj; on 'You don't.' they snap open into a hard, focused, determined stare straight ahead. As they open, the camera punches in with a brutal zoom toward her pupils and the frame ends in a white flash that cuts into the dream. Extreme close-up, 100mm, crash zoom in the last half-second. Cold bluish interior light, dim, desaturated, then blown-out white. The switch to the dream is not announced: no blur, no dissolve, no dreamy effect.
shots.script: Gros plan sur ses yeux qui s'ouvrent. Transition : flash ou zoom brutal vers le rêve.

shots.description: Overhead : espace ouvert, les voleurs en cercle autour du salon de jardin et du vélo. JJ avance dans la lumière, en silhouette.
shots.notes: Plan 52 du dossier. Paroles : In broad daylight, | Cercle autour du salon de jardin et du vélo : v2 (plan 47 v2).
shots.detail: Top-down overhead shot of @arene-du-reve-de-combat, a two-level traditional Japanese wooden dojo: @les-voleurs stand in a circle around JJ's stolen @salon-de-jardin and @velo-electrique-de-jj placed in the middle of the square pit of glass slabs lit from below over white raked sand, framed by the honey-coloured wooden floor. From the edge of frame @jj walks in, a dark silhouette inside a single hard beam of light, and advances slowly toward them; they turn their heads toward her. Overhead, 24mm, locked-off, perfect symmetry on the grid of glowing slabs. Saturated pink, electric blue and red neon accents washing over the wood, the shoji screens and the glowing glass, low haze, deep shadows, high contrast. Ultra-cinematic, serious, mythic: the dream fight begins. No gag, no comic pose.
shots.script: Overhead : espace ouvert, les voleurs en cercle autour du salon de jardin et du vélo. JJ avance dans la lumière, en silhouette.

shots.description: Overhead : elle enfonce le portail d'un coup de pied, il s'écrase à plat au sol.
shots.camera: static, top-down overhead, slow motion on impact
shots.notes: Plan 53 du dossier. Paroles : They went through my stuff, | « Il s'écrase au sol » : v2 (plan 48 v2).
shots.detail: Top-down overhead in @arene-du-reve-de-combat, the two-level Japanese wooden dojo: @portail-du-jardin stands closed across the honey-coloured wooden floor at the edge of the glowing glass-slab pit, between @jj and @les-voleurs. JJ strides up and smashes it with one straight front kick; the gate rips loose and falls flat onto the glass slabs in slow motion, sending up a ring of haze and fine white sand, the underlit slabs flaring around it. Overhead, 24mm, locked-off, symmetrical on the grid of slabs, slow motion at the impact. Saturated pink, electric blue and red neon accents washing over the wood, the shoji screens and the glowing glass, low haze, deep shadows, high contrast. Third signature image: this time she is the one who goes through the gate. Serious and cinematic, no gag. No boots, no rock styling.
shots.script: Overhead : elle enfonce le portail d'un coup de pied, il s'écrase à plat au sol.

shots.description: Gros plan : regard intense. Elle arrache un barreau de la chaise cassée.
shots.notes: Plan 54 du dossier. Paroles : Took what they wanted,
shots.detail: Close-up in @arene-du-reve-de-combat, the Japanese wooden dojo: @jj's face, lit by a hard neon beam, an intense, cold stare fixed on @les-voleurs, who stay off-screen. Without looking down she grips the back of @chaise-en-plastique-cassee beside her and rips a rung clean off with one sharp pull; the plastic cracks; she raises the rung into frame like a blade. Behind her, out of focus, backlit white shoji screens and dark wooden posts. Close-up, 85mm, slow push-in, brief slow motion on the snap. Pink and blue neon rim light, cool white glow rising from the glass slabs below, deep shadows, low haze, high contrast. Mythic and deadly serious: the broken chair becomes her weapon. No headband, no comic gesture, no garden hose, no nunchaku.
shots.script: Gros plan : regard intense. Elle arrache un barreau de la chaise cassée.

shots.description: Chorégraphie de combat, travelling latéral, ralentis, le barreau de chaise comme arme.
shots.notes: Plan 55 du dossier. Paroles : Like it wasn't enough. | « Le barreau comme arme » : v2 (plan 50 v2).
shots.detail: Fight choreography in @arene-du-reve-de-combat, the two-level Japanese wooden dojo: @jj moves through @les-voleurs in one continuous line across the glass slabs lit from below over white raked sand, using the white rung torn from @chaise-en-plastique-cassee as a short stick: she ducks a punch in slow motion, strikes a wrist, spins and sweeps a leg; the thieves go down one after another as she passes. In the background, the wooden staircase, the shoji screens and the platform with the painted dragon screen slide by. Long lateral tracking shot following her left to right at body height, 35mm, speed ramping from real time into slow motion on each hit. Saturated pink, electric blue and red neon accents washing over the wood and the glowing glass, low haze, deep shadows, high contrast. Precise, graceful, ultra-cinematic. Nothing kitsch: no comic sound gag, no fake wind in the hair, no cartoon slow motion.
shots.script: Chorégraphie de combat, travelling latéral, ralentis, le barreau de chaise comme arme.

shots.description: Le chien traverse le cadre au ralenti, bondit sur un voleur.
shots.notes: Plan 56 du dossier.
shots.detail: Slow motion in @arene-du-reve-de-combat, the Japanese wooden dojo: @alister bursts into frame from the left, running flat out across the honey-coloured wooden floor, ears back, and leaps across the frame onto one of @les-voleurs, knocking him down onto the glass slabs lit from below, then stands over him, heroic. Behind them, backlit shoji screens and dark wooden posts. Medium-wide, 50mm, side-on lateral track matching the dog's run, full slow motion. Saturated pink, electric blue and red neon accents washing over the wood and the glowing glass, low haze, deep shadows, high contrast. Heroic payoff for the dog who gave up behind the glass: in the dream, he gets even. No tear, no cartoon effect.
shots.script: Le chien traverse le cadre au ralenti, bondit sur un voleur.

shots.description: Plan large symétrique : voleurs KO. JJ debout, souffle lent.
shots.notes: Plan 57 du dossier. Paroles : I paid for this town,
shots.detail: Wide symmetrical shot of @arene-du-reve-de-combat, the two-level Japanese wooden dojo: @les-voleurs lie knocked out on the glass slabs lit from below over white raked sand, around @jj, motionless. JJ stands in the center of the glowing pit, the rung of @chaise-en-plastique-cassee hanging from her hand, breathing slowly and deeply, shoulders rising and falling, hair settling. Behind her, the wooden staircase to the gallery, the shoji screens and the platform with the painted dragon screen. Haze drifts. Wide, 24mm, locked-off, perfect symmetry, slight slow motion. Saturated pink, electric blue and red neon accents washing over the wood and the glowing glass, low haze, deep shadows, high contrast. Calm after the storm: she paid for this town. The thieves stay silent and still: no squeaking, no rat gag.
shots.script: Plan large symétrique : voleurs KO. JJ debout, souffle lent.

shots.description: Gyrophares de police balayant les murs.
shots.notes: Plan 58 du dossier.
shots.detail: In @arene-du-reve-de-combat, the two-level Japanese wooden dojo, red and blue police lights start sweeping across the backlit shoji screens, the dark wooden posts and the painted dragon screen from off-screen, as if patrol cars were arriving outside; the rotating beams slide through the haze and over the knocked-out @les-voleurs lying on the glowing glass slabs in the background. No police car and no officer visible, only their lights. Medium-wide, 35mm, static camera. The neon palette of the dream crossed by rotating red and blue flashes, deep shadows, high contrast. Justice arriving at last; the thieves stay down and silent. No sound gag, no rat squeaks.
shots.script: Gyrophares de police balayant les murs.

shots.description: JJ reprend son vélo, paillasson « Welcome » sous le bras, regard caméra.
shots.notes: Plan 59 du dossier. Paroles : And they walk away.
shots.detail: In @arene-du-reve-de-combat, the Japanese wooden dojo, @jj walks across the glowing glass slabs to @velo-electrique-de-jj, lifts it by the handlebar and sets it upright; she picks up the coir @paillasson-welcome from the slabs, tucks it under her arm, then turns her head and looks straight into the camera, deadpan. Behind her, backlit shoji screens and the wooden staircase, swept by red and blue police lights. Medium shot, 35mm, slow push-in to her face for the look. Saturated pink, electric blue and red neon accents washing over the wood, cool white glow rising from the glass below, low haze, high contrast. Triumphant and dry: this time she is the one who walks away with her things. The WELCOME lettering readable on the mat.
shots.script: JJ reprend son vélo, paillasson « Welcome » sous le bras, regard caméra.

shots.description: JJ se réveille sur le canapé, même position, même tenue. Plan du dessus.
shots.notes: Plan 60 du dossier. Paroles : Nobody saw.
shots.detail: Overhead shot, camera straight above the sofa of @salon-de-jj, the exact framing of the falling-asleep shot: JJ sits cross-legged, head back on the top of the backrest, curls spread on the grey fabric, phone in her lap, in the same office outfit. A long stillness, then her eyes open; she stays still a moment, looking up, coming back to reality, then slowly lifts her head. Top-down overhead, 28mm, locked-off static camera. Cold bluish interior light, dim, low contrast, desaturated palette. The neon is gone. She wakes without a jolt, in the same position she fell asleep in: no start, no fighting pose, no dog on her legs.
shots.script: JJ se réveille sur le canapé, même position, même tenue. Plan du dessus.

shots.description: Elle tourne la tête vers la fenêtre d'où elle voyait son vélo. Jardin vide.
shots.notes: Plan 61 du dossier. Paroles : Nobody heard.
shots.detail: On the sofa of @salon-de-jj, JJ slowly turns her head toward the window from which she used to see her bike. Through the glass, @jardin-de-jj: the empty courtyard in daylight, the bare spot against the wall where the bike stood, @chaise-en-plastique-cassee alone. Her face in cold bluish interior light, against the bright courtyard outside. Medium shot from behind her shoulder toward the window, 35mm, slow rack focus from her profile to the empty courtyard. Cold desaturated interior, bright exterior. Quiet realization: the theft was real.
shots.script: Elle tourne la tête vers la fenêtre d'où elle voyait son vélo. Jardin vide.

shots.description: Elle soupire. Le vol était bien réel, pas le combat.
shots.notes: Plan 62 du dossier.
shots.detail: Medium close-up of JJ on the sofa of @salon-de-jj, still facing the window, the empty courtyard bright beyond the glass. She lets out a long, slow sigh: shoulders lift and drop, eyes half-close, lips pressed together. The dream fight is gone; the empty courtyard is not. Medium close-up, 50mm, three-quarter profile, locked-off static camera. Cold bluish interior light, dim, low contrast, desaturated palette. The bright window acts as a soft backlight on her curls. Weary, lucid, honest: the theft was real, the fight was not.
shots.script: Elle soupire. Le vol était bien réel, pas le combat.

shots.description: Léger sourire en coin, avec une pointe d'amertume. Ce n'était qu'un rêve, mais ça lui a fait du bien, c'est déjà ça.
shots.notes: Plan 63 du dossier.
shots.detail: Close-up of JJ on the sofa of @salon-de-jj. After the sigh, the corner of her mouth slowly lifts into a slight, lopsided half-smile, a little bitter, eyes still on the empty courtyard, then a small exhale through the nose, almost a laugh. It was only a dream, but it did her good: that's something. Close-up, 85mm, very slow push-in. Cold bluish interior light, dim, low contrast, desaturated palette. The bright window as soft backlight. Bittersweet, self-mocking ending, the last image before the cut. A slight smile, not a grin.
shots.script: Léger sourire en coin, avec une pointe d'amertume. Ce n'était qu'un rêve, mais ça lui a fait du bien, c'est déjà ça.

blocks.name: Pré-refrain 1

blocks.name: Rap : le jardin vide

blocks.name: Pont : « I understand »
blocks.intention: Tout tombe : canapé, téléphone, voix calme et standardisée. Lumière froide intérieure, plans fixes, aucun gag. Elle s'endort sans que le spectateur le sache.
blocks.look: Cold bluish interior light, dim, the daylight from the window turned grey-blue, low contrast, desaturated palette, stillness, fine grain.
blocks.brief: Tout tombe : canapé, téléphone, voix calme et standardisée. Lumière froide intérieure, plans fixes, aucun gag. Elle s'endort sans que le spectateur le sache.

blocks.name: Refrain final : le combat
blocks.intention: Le rêve, sérieux et ultra cinématographique façon Kill Bill / John Wick 4 : overhead, symétrie, ralentis, néons, couleurs saturées. Pas de gag kitsch.

blocks.brief: Le rêve, sérieux et ultra cinématographique façon Kill Bill / John Wick 4 : overhead, symétrie, ralentis, néons, couleurs saturées. Pas de gag kitsch.
